title.win.description: Title of the shared end-of-game result card when the outcome is a win.

title.loss.description: Title of the shared end-of-game result card for an unnamed loss (e.g. a solo game ending badly).

title.lossNamed.description: Title of the result card when the player loses to a named opponent.
title.lossNamed.notes: {{name}} is the winning opponent's display name, e.g. an AI difficulty persona or another seat's name.

title.draw.description: Title of the result card for a tied outcome.

title.ended.description: Title of the result card for a game that ended without a win/loss/draw outcome (e.g. no more moves, or leaving a session).

hero.you.description: Label for the player's own score in the head-to-head hero display of the result card.

hero.vs.description: Short separator between the two scores in the head-to-head hero display.

newBest.description: Badge shown on the result card when the player's score beats their previous best.

action.playAgain.description: Primary button on the result card to start a new game.

action.home.description: Button on the result card to return to the home screen.

action.viewLeaderboard.description: Link on the result card that opens the game's leaderboard.

submission.saving.description: Status line on the result card while the score is being submitted to the leaderboard.

submission.saved.description: Status line on the result card once the score has been saved to the leaderboard.
submission.saved.notes: {{name}} is the display name the score was saved under.

submission.savedRanked.description: Status line on the result card once the score has been saved, including its leaderboard rank.
submission.savedRanked.notes: {{name}} is the display name the score was saved under; {{rank}} is a 1-based position.

submission.savedBest.description: Status line on the result card when this game is saved but an earlier game is the player's best entry on the board.
submission.savedBest.notes: {{name}} is the player's display name; {{rank}} is the 1-based position of their best entry.

submission.offline.description: Status line on the result card when the score was saved locally while offline, to sync later.

submission.error.description: Status line on the result card when saving the score to the leaderboard failed.

submission.retry.description: Retry link next to the submission error line on the result card.

namePrompt.label.description: Label for the one-time display-name prompt shown in the result card's submission slot, before a first score can be saved to a leaderboard.

namePrompt.helper.description: Helper text under the one-time display-name prompt on the result card.
namePrompt.helper.notes: Refers to the Profile screen, where the name can be changed later.

a11y.announce.description: Accessibility label — combined screen-reader announcement of the result title and detail, read once when the card appears.
a11y.announce.notes: {{title}} and {{detail}} are other, already-translated strings joined together.

a11y.heroScore.description: Accessibility hint text — the score-hero's label and value, folded into the result announcement.

a11y.heroVs.description: Accessibility hint text — the versus-hero's two scores, folded into the result announcement.
a11y.heroVs.notes: {{opponent}} is the opponent's display label (e.g. an AI difficulty persona).

a11y.dismissCelebration.description: Accessibility label for the full-screen tap-to-skip area shown during a win celebration animation, before the result card appears.

stat.score.component: Game screens' result cards (Sudoku, 2048, Yacht, Star Swarm, Cascade, Solitaire, Mahjong)
stat.score.description: Stat label for the game's score, shown in the result card's hero or stat strip.

stat.time.component: Game screens' result cards (Sudoku, Solitaire, Mahjong)
stat.time.description: Stat label for elapsed time, shown in the result card's stat strip.

stat.errors.description: Stat label for the number of mistakes made, shown in the result card's stat strip.

stat.best.component: Game screens' result cards (Sudoku, Sort Puzzle, FreeCell, Star Swarm, Cascade, Solitaire, Mahjong)
stat.best.description: Stat label for the player's best score or time to date, shown in the result card's stat strip.

stat.moves.component: Game screens' result cards (Sort Puzzle, FreeCell, Solitaire)
stat.moves.description: Stat label for the number of moves made, shown in the result card's hero or stat strip.

stat.merges.description: Stat label for the number of fruit merges made, shown in the result card's stat strip.

action.changeDifficulty.component: Game screens' result cards (Sudoku, Yacht, Star Swarm, Hearts)
action.changeDifficulty.description: Secondary button on the result card to go back and pick a different difficulty or opponent style.

name.computer.description: Stand-in opponent name used as the winner's name when the AI beats the player in Yacht vs mode.

margin.won_one.description: Result card subtitle giving the winning margin when the player wins by exactly one point.

margin.won_other.description: Result card subtitle giving the winning margin when the player wins by more than one point.

margin.lost_one.description: Result card subtitle giving the losing margin when the player loses by exactly one point.

margin.lost_other.description: Result card subtitle giving the losing margin when the player loses by more than one point.

margin.tied.description: Result card subtitle shown when both players finish Yacht with the same score.

stat.upper.description: Stat label for the upper-section score, shown in the Yacht result card's stat strip.

stat.lower.description: Stat label for the lower-section score, shown in the Yacht result card's stat strip.

stat.bonus.description: Stat label for the upper-section bonus, shown in the Yacht result card's stat strip.

subtitle.noMoves.description: Result card subtitle shown when the 2048 board has no more legal moves.

stat.guesses.description: Stat label for the number of guesses used, shown in the result card's stat strip.

subtitle.solvedIn_one.description: Result card subtitle for a win, singular form ({{count}} = 1 guess).

subtitle.solvedIn_other.description: Result card subtitle for a win, plural form.

action.changeMode.description: Secondary button on the result card to go back and pick a different Solitaire mode.

subtitle.completedIn_one.description: Result card subtitle for a win, singular form ({{count}} = 1 move).

subtitle.completedIn_other.description: Result card subtitle for a win, plural form.

subtitle.reachedLimit.description: Result card subtitle naming which player crossed the score limit that ended the Hearts game.

standings.label.description: Accessibility label for the ranked final-standings list on the Hearts result card.

standings.row.description: Accessibility label for one row of the Hearts final-standings list.

action.changeLayout.description: Secondary button on the result card to go back and pick a different Mahjong layout.

subtitle.pairsCleared_one.description: Result card subtitle for a win, singular form ({{count}} = 1 pair).

subtitle.pairsCleared_other.description: Result card subtitle for a win, plural form.

subtitle.noFreePairs.description: Result card subtitle shown when the Mahjong board has no more matchable pairs.

action.undoLastMove.description: Button (and its accessibility label) on the result card to undo the last move instead of ending the game.

stat.undos.description: Stat label for the number of undos used, shown in the result card's stat strip.

action.nextLevel.description: Primary button on the result card to advance to the next Sort Puzzle level.

action.changeLevel.description: Secondary button on the result card to go back to the level-select screen.

stat.hands.description: Stat label for the number of Blackjack hands played, shown in the result card's stat strip.

stat.biggestWin.description: Stat label for the biggest single win of the session, shown in the result card's stat strip.

stat.winRate.description: Stat label for the session's hand win rate, shown in the result card's stat strip.

stat.netPL.description: Stat label for the session's net profit/loss in chips, shown in the result card's stat strip.
stat.netPL.notes: P/L is a common finance abbreviation for profit/loss; keep it short.

a11y.cashOutHome.description: Accessibility label for the Home button on the Blackjack victory result card, which cashes out the session and ends the run.
